question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark(?) in the following figures series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/950ba1975fe5f0269e2d7dacc26c28e3dd224f97585df95072a3346aaf66d6d5.png]
solution:
Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/950ba1975fe5f0269e2d7dacc26c28e3dd224f97585df95072a3346aaf66d6d5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f6bb7c2c94d3dedd4677706c3e393d88da4e5a2cffadf7bca0c0a6de81eb5bd.png] → upper part shaded in the first step and lower in the next step, thus the same pattern continues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2e90c3f24aa634079100e8c2003b6e6808227ac4ca84ac68bd1a3acb3f6210d.png] → moves 90° in the clockwise direction, shaded in first and not shaded in next step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df07763fb0a679db0e3e480ebb532e0f3cfe97088c0a161bb917440568237b0.png] → moves 90° in the clockwise direction, and 90° anticlockwise in its own orientation. 

The complete series is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d418c517ea98018f7c3ec196888d252959f1fa5bd0a534d36003470924359542.png] 

Hence, **option (1) **is the correct answer.
